items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Musterquellen – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: The scanned envelope on page 2 records the formal service (förmliche Zustellung, § 182 ZPO) date as 'zugest. 21.11.2026' (Saturday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service itself is not counted, so the two-week Einspruchsfrist starts Sun 22 Nov 2026. Under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a two-week period ends two weeks later, i.e. Sat 5 Dec 2026. Since that falls on a Saturday, § 193 BGB (via § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG) shifts the last day to the next business day, Mon 7 Dec 2026.

items.title: Pay the fine once the notice becomes final
items.quote: Zahlen Sie erst, wenn dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, und dann binnen zwei Wochen auf das Konto DE29 5135 0025 0002 1403 00.
items.computation: Payment is expressly conditional on the Bescheid becoming rechtskräftig (final), which occurs only if no Einspruch is filed within the objection period computed above, i.e. at the close of Mon 7 Dec 2026. Treating that as the triggering event, § 187 Abs. 1 BGB excludes that day, so the two-week payment period starts Tue 8 Dec 2026 and, under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, ends Mon 21 Dec 2026 — a business day, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. This date is only valid if the person does not lodge an Einspruch; filing one suspends the payment obligation until the resulting proceeding concludes.

warnings: The payment deadline (2026-12-21) only applies if no Einspruch is filed by 2026-12-07; filing an objection removes this payment obligation for now, so do not pay before checking whether you intend to object.

Before transferring money, verify the IBAN DE29 5135 0025 0002 1403 00 and the payee name against an independent, trusted source (e.g. a prior official notice or the city's official website) rather than relying solely on this letter, as is good practice for any unsolicited payment request.

The sender's printed email address (bussgeld@stadt-musterquellen-bußgelds.example) uses an unusual domain that does not match a typical German municipal domain — double-check this against the city's official contact details before using it.
